approach: int param copied to local, compared via local (many variants: temp var, u32, pointer indirection)
diff_signature: target 'adds r4,r0,#0; cmp r4,#4' vs MWCC 'adds r4,r0,#0; cmp r0,#4' at function entry
lesson: MWCC copy-propagates parameter copies back to r0 in comparisons; 'cmp r4' after a param copy only occurs for saved return values (after a bl). Pure C cannot produce this — use NONMATCHING inline asm.
